The '''Imperial Space Control''' was a department of the Galactic Empire responsible of issuing official permits for the installation of weaponry on non-military [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. 

After a request for the obtainment of a permit was made in one of the various Imperial Space Control offices found in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the office decided to grant or deny it depending on the background and criminal record of the applicant and the grade of the weapon requested, with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] being outright prohibited from being mounted on private vessels under normal circumstances.<ref name="GG6-TrampF" />
